items.headline: Manchester United beat AC Milan 4-2 in pre-season friendly
items.summary: United lost to AC Milan 4-2 in a pre-season friendly match in Wrocław on August 15.

items.headline: Marcus Rashford returns from injury in pre-season action
items.summary: Rashford made his first appearance in 20 months during the AC Milan friendly after extended absence.

items.headline: Lisandro Martinez returns from summer break
items.summary: Martinez has returned from his summer holiday as United prepare for the competitive season.

items.headline: Evans influenced Tielemans signing decision
items.summary: Evans played a role in United's decision to pursue the signing of Tielemans during pre-season.

items.headline: Carrick confident pre-season preparations on track
items.summary: Manager Michael Carrick says United's pre-season programme is progressing as planned ahead of the season.
